component.name: VectorCraft
component.summary: Draw and edit vector illustrations, SVG and PDF

description.p: This is a community package of VectorCraft, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the VectorCraft project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.
VectorCraft is an open-source, native vector illustration app written in Rust that follows the Adobe Illustrator workflow: the same layout, tools, menus, panels and shortcuts.

ul.li: Pen, Direct Selection, shape and brush tools, artboards and type
Fills, strokes, gradients and live effects
Exact curve booleans and unlimited undo
A documented native format (.vectorcraft), plus SVG and PDF
Every menu item, tool and panel can be driven by AI agents over a JSON control channel

description.p: The headless command runner and MCP server is included: flatpak run --command=vectorcraft-cli ai.storyteller.vectorcraft --help

Permissions: this package uses the same sandbox as upstream's own Flatpak manifest: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback), the GPU device, and the Pictures folder. Files anywhere else are opened and saved through the system file chooser. No network access is granted.

ul.li: Let agents on the host reach the --control automation server: flatpak override --user --share=network ai.storyteller.vectorcraft
Open files by path anywhere in your home folder (command line, Open Recent): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.vectorcraft
